sentences.text:
The present Writ Petition has been filed for the issuance of a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, to quash the impugned Refusal Check Slip dated 24.04.2025 bearing Refusal Number RLF/ntspg;gl;bdk;/18/2025 and consequently, to direct the 2nd respondent herein to register the settlement deed dated 24.04.2020 in respect of the property in S.No.279/1A to an extent of 2 Acres 4 Cents situated at Perungulam Ulkadai Usilankattuvalasai Village, Ramanathapuram Taluk,
Ramanathapuram District.
2.The contention of the petitioner is that he is owning 2 Acres 4 Cents in the said land and he is intended to give the said property to his son through settlement deed dated 24.04.2020.
But the respondents are refusing to register the same stating that there is acquisition proceedings by the Indian Naval Station located at Ramanathapuram District.
But it is seen that the said acquisition proceedings was not acted upon and it was dropped over a period of time.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

3.The learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents submitted that even though the previous acquisition proceedings was dropped, now, there is a reinitiation of acquisition proceedings for which he relied on the letter, dated 03.04.2025 in D.O.Letter No.5132/Military/2024-5.
There are several proceedings in one of the proceedings, dated 23.04.2025, it is requested to send the land schedule in order to proceed further.

The learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents further submitted that since the reinitiation of acquisition proceedings is there, the respondents are objecting to register the said sale deed.

4.After considering the rival submissions, this Court is of the considered opinion that since it is only a settlement deed, the respondents have no valid ground to refuse to register the same and the acquisition by the Indian Naval Station is only in initial stage.
The Indian Naval Station cannot object in the initial stage itself.
If the Indian Naval Station is intended to acquire the same, it can be done as per law.
5.Therefore, the respondents are directed to register the settlement deed.
If any acquisition proceedings are done by the Indian Naval Station, the settlee in the settlement deed is entitled to the compensation under the acquisition proceedings.

However, if the settlee is intended to put any construction or https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 17/06/2025 10:52:23 am ) develop Gopal vs The District Registrar on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60437655/
2 the land, he may seek permission from the Indian Naval Station and thereafter, proceed further.
